steps.title: Opening positions
steps.rule: Stack 5m south of Kefka, behind him, out of Revolting Ruin III's cone.

MainTank.rule: Tank Kefka 5m north of the centre, facing him away from the party.

OffTank.rule: Wait 4m west of the centre, ready to take over.
Provoke and take Kefka's spot 5m north for the next hits.

MainTank.rule: Hand Kefka over and drop back to 4m west of the centre.

steps.title: Supports west, DPS east
steps.cue: Graven Image tethers one role group
steps.rule: Supports wait 5m west of Kefka, DPS 5m east. If your group has the Graven Image tethers, wait at the north wall on your side instead: the tether's Pulse Wave will push you back south.

steps.title: Read fire and ice, pre-position
steps.cue: Mystery Magic: fire and ice orbs on Kefka, fire markers
steps.rule: Pick the quadrant on your side that the real ice misses (a lie orb on Kefka means the telegraphed cones are the safe ones): supports in the west quadrant, DPS in the east one. Stack: the group gathers in the middle of that quadrant; spread: take your spread spot there. A lie fire orb means do the opposite of the markers. Tethered players stand 13m north of that spot so Pulse Wave pushes them into it.

MainTank.rule: Spread: on Kefka's hitbox, 6m north or south in your quadrant.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Spread: on Kefka's hitbox, 6m north or south in your quadrant.

OffTank.rule: Spread: 8m out, in the middle of your quadrant.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Spread: 8m out, in the middle of your quadrant.

RegenHealer.rule: Spread: far out at the edge of your quadrant.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Spread: far out at the edge of your quadrant.

ShieldHealer.rule: Spread: 6m out, close to the east-west line.

CasterDps.rule: Spread: 6m out, close to the east-west line.

steps.title: Settle for Flagrant Fire III
steps.cue: Pulse Wave knocks the tethered group south
steps.rule: After the knockback, settle into your stack or spread spot in your group's safe quadrant.

steps.title: Wave Cannon line
steps.rule: Line up 3m south of the centre, west to east: H2, H1, OT, MT, M1, M2, R1, R2. Wave Cannon hits four of you and drops a tower under each.

ShieldHealer.rule: West end of the line, at the wall.

CasterDps.rule: East end of the line, at the wall.

steps.title: Soak the towers
steps.cue: Explosion towers drop under the lasered players
steps.rule: If Wave Cannon hit you, step 6.5m north out of your tower. If not, soak a tower on your half: the free players of your group take its towers in the same west-to-east order as the line.

steps.title: First confetti stack
steps.cue: Double-trouble Trap on one support and one DPS
steps.rule: Supports stack 6m west, DPS 6m east. The Double-trouble Trap player of your group stands 2.5m further out, so the stack's knockback pushes the group in toward the middle.

steps.title: Dodge lightning and ice
steps.cue: Mystery Magic: ice and lightning orbs on Kefka
steps.rule: From where the knockback left you, move to the nearest spot clear of both the real ice quadrants and the real Thrumming Thunder III lanes. A lie orb flips its element: the telegraphed cones or lines are then the safe ones.

steps.title: Regroup for Light of Judgment
steps.rule: Stack 5m south of Kefka again for Light of Judgment and the Hyperdrive busters.

OffTank.rule: Keep Kefka 5m north of the centre.

steps.title: Stack north for the first puddles
steps.cue: Blizzard III Blowout and the gravity and rock tethers
steps.rule: Everyone stacks 11m north, on the side the real ice misses: north-east if the real cones hit north-west and south-east, otherwise north-west. Gravitas drops its puddles here.

steps.title: First rocks spread
steps.rule: The gravity group gathers 3.5m south of the centre. The rock group spreads for Vitrophyre: MT and M1 at the far west, M2 at the far east, H1 and R1 south-west, H2 and R2 south-east.

OffTank.rule: Keep Kefka 5.5m north of the centre and bait Revolting Ruin III there.

MainTank.rule: Rocks: far west. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Rocks: far west. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Rocks: far east. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Rocks: south-west, 8m south. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Rocks: south-west, 8m south. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Rocks: south-east, 8m south. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Rocks: south-east, 8m south. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

steps.title: Dodge the first half-room Will
steps.rule: Stack 6m out on the half away from the Will statue that winds up: the east statue cleaves the east half, the west one the west half.

OffTank.rule: Stay north on Kefka, sliding 4m to the safe side.

steps.title: Stack south for the second puddles
steps.rule: Everyone stacks on waymark C, south, so the second Gravitas puddles drop there.

steps.title: Second rocks spread
steps.rule: The gravity group gathers 3m south of the centre. The rock group spreads across the north half: MT and M1 far west, OT and M2 8m west, H1 and R1 8m east, H2 and R2 far east.

MainTank.rule: Rocks: far west. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Rocks: far west. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Rocks: 8m west, slightly north. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Rocks: 8m west, slightly north. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Rocks: 8m east, slightly north. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Rocks: 8m east, slightly north. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Rocks: far east. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Rocks: far east. Gravity: stack south of the centre.

steps.title: Dodge the second half-room Will
steps.cue: Vitrophyre resolves, a Will statue winds up
steps.rule: Stack 6m out on the half away from the winding-up Will statue.

steps.title: Second confetti: line up through Kefka
steps.rule: Supports stack just north of Kefka, DPS just south of him in line with the north puddles. Each group's Double-trouble Trap player stands at the edge of the puddles on their own side, so the knockback throws the group through Kefka into the puddles opposite.

MainTank.rule: Just north of Kefka, or 6m north if you hold the Trap.

OffTank.rule: Just north of Kefka, or 6m north if you hold the Trap.

RegenHealer.rule: Just north of Kefka, or 6m north if you hold the Trap.

ShieldHealer.rule: Just north of Kefka, or 6m north if you hold the Trap.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Just south of Kefka, or 6m south if you hold the Trap.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Just south of Kefka, or 6m south if you hold the Trap.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Just south of Kefka, or 6m south if you hold the Trap.

CasterDps.rule: Just south of Kefka, or 6m south if you hold the Trap.

steps.title: Pop the puddles
steps.cue: Double-trouble Trap knocks you through Kefka
steps.rule: Stand in the puddles you were knocked into: supports in the south ones, DPS in the north ones. Trap holders step back into the puddles behind them.

steps.title: Regroup for the second Light of Judgment

MainTank.rule: Tank Kefka 5m north of the centre.
